query: SELECT id AS "id!: VfAccountId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE (id > $2) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE ($2 IS NULL) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $1) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $1) __ids ORDER BY id ASC
